name: DS Cluster D07: Economic Indicators (Intraday — ffill on sparse 1-bar data)
description: Tests: FRED CPI appears on 1 bar per observation date on intraday, ffill carries through all bars.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER D07 INTRADAY: FRED ffill on 1-bar-per-date
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# === CPI: raw is 1 bar per observation date (99.98% null on intraday) ===
cpi_src = common_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.CPI)()
cpi = ffill(cpi_src.result)

# === Fed Funds ===
ff_src = common_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.FedFunds)()
fed_funds = ffill(ff_src.result)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title="CPI (ffill'd on intraday)",
    category="Macro",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="CPI", color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=cpi)

xy_lines(
    title="Fed Funds (ffill'd on intraday)",
    category="Macro",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Fed Funds", color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=fed_funds)
